dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、もしかして今“かったるい”とかって思っ
　てましたね、先輩」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, don't tell me you're thinking "How troublesome" to
yourself now, senpai!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, don't tell me you're thinking "How troublesome" to
yourself now, senpai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「よく分かったな。そういうわけで俺は行く」
dialogues.en: "Good job, Miharu. I'd be going now."
dialogues.text: "Good job, Miharu. I'd be going now."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩は、猫さんがかわいそうだとは思わない
　んですか？　人でなしさんなんですかぁ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Senpai, don't you feel sorry for the cat? Are you so
uncaring!?"
dialogues.text:
"Senpai, don't you feel sorry for the cat? Are you so
uncaring!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……猫ならこのぐらいの高さ、大丈夫だって」
dialogues.en:
"...The cat's only at that height, it should be able to jump
down by itself."
dialogues.text:
"...The cat's only at that height, it should be able to jump
down by itself."

dialogues.jp: そういう生き物なんだから。
「じゃあな、そういうことでアディオス！」

爽やかな挨拶に答える美春の声を背後に聞きな
がら、軽く手をあげてその場を後にする。
dialogues.en:
Quickly turning my back to Miharu with that cheerful
farewell, I head off and lightly wave goodbye.
dialogues.text:
Quickly turning my back to Miharu with that cheerful
farewell, I head off and lightly wave goodbye.

dialogues.jp: 猫を助けるなんてかったるい。
dialogues.en: It was too troublesome to save that cat.
dialogues.text: It was too troublesome to save that cat.

dialogues.jp: そんな訳で俺は、いつもの日常に戻る事にした。
dialogues.en: With that esxcuse, I went back home as usual.
dialogues.text: With that esxcuse, I went back home as usual.
